charts.title: Repeat matching vs the BioSimulators reference (3-model validation subset)
charts.caption: Per (engine, model) repeat arm: green = observables matched to the BioSimulators reference under numpy allclose; grey = reference observables; red -N = reference observables not yet computed (coverage gap).
charts.interpretation: Iteration 1 left 17/48 (BIOMD1-2) and 7-9 (BIOMD3) reference observables uncomputed. Iteration 2 ('full observable coverage') closed the gap: BIOMD1/BIOMD2 reach 65/65, BIOMD3 14/14 computed with 2 reference observables still unsupported. Where an observable is computed, 12/12 repeat arms matched exactly — the dominant failure mode is coverage, not numerical divergence.
